complaints.title: Demanding urgent redelivery today but refusing to provide correct house address in DHA Karachi
complaints.description: I ordered urgent documents via CN-9018274610 to Phase 6 DHA Karachi. The rider marked unreachable! I need this delivered within 1 hour immediately! But do not call my mobile number because I am in meetings all day, and I won't share my alternate house gate number because of privacy concerns. Just tell your rider to deliver it at my house gate right now without calling!
complaints.requested_resolution: Immediate delivery within 1 hour without calling recipient or getting updated address details

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Customer address incomplete or ambiguous preventing first-attempt delivery
expected_ground_truth.secondary_issue: Consignee unreachable during scheduled delivery attempt window
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Contradictory request: Consignee demands immediate redelivery within 1 hour but explicitly refuses to provide gate details or answer phone calls for rider verification.

complaints.title: Merchant wants parcel returned immediately to Lahore warehouse but insists consignee must receive it tomorrow
complaints.description: Regarding COD booking CN-3391028472 dispatched to Faisalabad. The buyer contacted us saying they might be out of city, so we want you to initiate immediate Return to Origin (RTO) back to our Gulberg Lahore warehouse today. But if the customer is back tomorrow, your rider must deliver it to them in Faisalabad without any extra charge! Ensure you process both return and delivery simultaneously.
complaints.requested_resolution: Simultaneously process return to origin and hold for next-day buyer delivery

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Merchant requesting mid-transit consignee address or contact modification
expected_ground_truth.secondary_issue: Merchant requests consignment cancellation while parcel is out for delivery
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Contradictory operational directive: Shipper simultaneously requests RTO initiation and customer delivery preservation; standard RTO protocol cancels outbound delivery.

complaints.title: Insisting fragile glass chandelier was packed perfectly while admitting it was shipped in a plastic flyer
complaints.description: We sent a delicate glass chandelier from Multan to Islamabad under CN-7718293041. The box arrived shattered. We demand 100% compensation of PKR 45,000! We packed it extremely safely inside a single RaftarXpress plastic courier flyer with two layers of newspaper. Your loaders must have thrown it! The flyer was completely sealed, so your rough handling broke the glass!
complaints.requested_resolution: Full compensation of PKR 45,000 for shattered glass chandelier

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Parcel contents damaged due to non-compliant or inadequate customer packaging
expected_ground_truth.secondary_issue: Damage to fragile or glassware items shipped without declared fragile handling
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Contradictory and unsupported claim: Complainant asserts adequate packaging while explicitly disclosing fragile glassware was shipped in a flyer with newspaper, violating DOC-002 packaging standards.

complaints.title: Customer demands instant COD cash refund without returning the received smartphone
complaints.description: I received parcel CN-5529104820 in Rawalpindi with a mobile phone. The color is blue instead of black! I paid PKR 32,000 cash to the rider. I want RaftarXpress to transfer PKR 32,000 back to my JazzCash right now. However, I will keep the blue phone until the merchant sends the black phone next week, so your rider cannot collect this parcel back. Just send my money!
complaints.requested_resolution: Instant COD cash refund via JazzCash while retaining the delivered merchandise

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Consignee disputes COD amount after delivery completion
expected_ground_truth.secondary_issue: Customer received incorrect merchandise from merchant delivered intact by courier
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Contradictory merchant-product dispute: Consignee demands logistics cash refund while refusing to return goods; RaftarXpress is solely the delivery agent, not the merchant.

complaints.title: Corporate client claims freight container was never delivered but admits their factory unloaded the cargo
complaints.description: Regarding heavy freight booking FWD-8819203 from Port Qasim to Sundar Industrial Estate Lahore. We are writing to report total non-delivery of consignment. Your tracking is fraudulent! Our factory supervisor had to manually unload the 20-ton steel coils at Bay 4 yesterday afternoon because your driver was delayed by 2 hours. Since your driver didn't do the offloading, this counts as zero delivery, so we demand full freight invoice cancellation!
complaints.requested_resolution: Full cancellation of PKR 185,000 freight invoice due to alleged non-delivery

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Client disputes line-haul freight invoice after successful delivery completion
expected_ground_truth.secondary_issue: Commercial freight delivery delayed under 6 hours without contractual SLA breach
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Contradictory claim: Client claims non-delivery to avoid invoice payment while explicitly confirming successful arrival and physical unloading at factory premises.

complaints.title: Demanding rider be penalized for opening flyer when consignee forced rider to open it for inspection
complaints.description: I received parcel CN-1109283745 in North Nazimabad Karachi. I forced the delivery boy at the door to tear open the flyer before I paid COD because I wanted to check the dress material. Now I saw the dress is unstitched chiffon and I don't like it! I want you to fire the rider for violating the Open Box Delivery policy, and take this opened dress back and refund my PKR 4,500!
complaints.requested_resolution: Penalize rider, force return of opened merchandise, and issue full cash refund

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Customer forced courier rider into unauthorized open-box inspection prior to payment
expected_ground_truth.secondary_issue: Rider allowed open-box inspection in violation of standard COD flyer policy
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Contradictory complaint: Consignee coerces rider into open-box flyer inspection and subsequently files complaint against rider for policy breach to return unwanted item.

complaints.title: Merchant claims inventory count discrepancy in warehouse while confirming stock tally matches audit
complaints.description: This is FashionHub Lahore (Merchant ID: MER-3918). We are logging a critical dispute against Lahore Fulfillment Center. We noticed our SKU-DR-902 showed 450 units in system yesterday and 450 units today, but we feel your staff moved boxes between rack A3 and rack B2 without notifying us! This is unacceptable mismanagement. We want compensation for missing stock even though physically all 450 dresses are present in the warehouse.
complaints.requested_resolution: Compensation for phantom inventory discrepancy despite identical unit count

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Merchant disputes internal warehouse inventory location tracking without physical unit loss
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Contradictory claim: Merchant demands financial compensation for lost inventory while explicitly verifying that physical audit numbers exactly equal system counts.

complaints.title: Demanding compensation for delayed delivery while acknowledging shipper booked on standard 5-day surface
complaints.description: My parcel CN-6610293847 from Peshawar to Karachi was booked on Economy Surface on Monday and arrived on Thursday (4 days). I am furious because I expected it to reach overnight like air cargo! Your counter agent explained Economy Surface takes 4-5 business days, but I don't care what the service tier says! I demand PKR 5,000 for mental torture and a 100% shipping refund for not flying it across the country!
complaints.requested_resolution: PKR 5,000 damages and full shipping refund for standard surface transit

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Consignee disputes standard economy ground transit time delivered within SLA window
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Contradictory expectation: Customer acknowledges selecting Economy Surface service and receiving consignment within 4 days, but demands Overnight Air SLA compensation.

complaints.title: Customer demands delivery to secret location without sharing location coordinates or landmark
complaints.description: I have consignment CN-8829104811 arriving in Islamabad. I do not want anyone in my street to see the delivery vehicle. Tell your driver to come to Sector F-10, park near a green tree, and wait for me. I cannot give a street number, sector sub-block, or phone number. If the parcel is delayed past 2 PM, I will sue RaftarXpress for gross negligence and breach of privacy!
complaints.requested_resolution: Deliver parcel to anonymous non-specific public landmark without phone contact

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Consignee refuses to provide verifiable physical delivery address or contact number
expected_ground_truth.secondary_issue: Consignee unreachable during scheduled delivery attempt window
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Contradictory request: Customer demands guaranteed delivery timing while refusing to disclose street, house number, GPS location, or contact number for delivery.

complaints.title: Demanding compensation for melted chocolates shipped via non-temperature-controlled dry parcel service
complaints.description: I shipped 10 kg of imported Belgian artisanal chocolates from Karachi to Multan under CN-3329104829 in peak July heat. The consignment was booked under standard dry overland parcel. Upon delivery, the consignee found the chocolates melted into liquid paste! Your customer service told me at booking that RaftarXpress standard parcel does not offer refrigerated transport, but you should have put ice packs in your normal truck anyway! Pay PKR 60,000 compensation immediately!
complaints.requested_resolution: Full compensation of PKR 60,000 for melted temperature-sensitive goods

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Spoilage or thermal degradation of temperature-sensitive items shipped via standard dry cargo
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Contradictory & policy violation: Shipper knowingly booked meltable confectionery under standard ambient dry service despite prior disclosure that cold-chain requires specialized booking.

complaints.title: Merchant demands instant remittance of COD funds before parcel is even handed over by customer
complaints.description: We are Apex Electronics (Merchant MER-8821). We booked consignment CN-9940182741 for COD delivery in Sialkot. The parcel is currently out for delivery with the rider. We want our finance settlement of PKR 19,500 transferred to our bank account this morning before 11 AM! If the rider delivers it this afternoon, why should we wait until the regular 48-hour settlement cycle? Transfer the money now or cancel our account!
complaints.requested_resolution: Pre-settlement remittance of COD funds prior to delivery collection and cycle maturity

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Merchant requesting premature COD payout before standard reconciliation cycle
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Contradictory financial demand: Merchant requests COD remittance before physical collection and settlement cycle maturity governed by SLA contract.

complaints.title: Client claims freight consignment was damaged by rain but confirms tarpaulin was never requested or paid for
complaints.description: We booked an open-top flatbed truck (FWD-1192038) for transporting 15 crates of unpainted machine parts from Karachi SITE to Gujranwala. It rained during transit on the highway near Sukkur, and superficial water spots appeared on the wooden crates. We demand 50% discount on freight charges! We know we selected the cheapest Open-Bed economy tariff without weather-proof containerization or tarpaulin cover, but your driver should have bought plastic sheets with his own money when it started raining!
complaints.requested_resolution: 50% freight charge reduction for rain exposure on open-bed vehicle

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Client claims weather exposure damage for open-bed freight booked without weather protection
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Contradictory freight claim: Client chose discounted open-bed transport without tarpaulin/containerization protection, yet demands compensation for environmental ambient exposure.

complaints.title: Customer complains rider refused to assemble furniture delivered under basic courier parcel booking
complaints.description: I ordered a flat-pack computer table from an online vendor, tracking CN-4401928374 delivered in Faisalabad. The delivery guy dropped off the 18 kg flat-pack box inside my drawing room and refused to assemble the table, tighten the screws, and level the legs! He claimed he is only a courier rider! I paid PKR 750 for courier delivery! If your company delivers furniture, your rider must build it! I want PKR 2,000 refund for assembling it myself.
complaints.requested_resolution: PKR 2,000 refund / compensation for performing self-assembly of delivered furniture

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Customer demands value-added assembly service not included in standard courier tariff
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Contradictory service scope expectation: Consignee demands courier staff provide free carpenter assembly services outside the standard parcel delivery tariff.

complaints.title: VIP account holder insists portal is broken while confirming their own internet went offline
complaints.description: We are Prestige Holdings (VIP Account VIP-441). We attempted to generate 80 bulk airway bills this morning at 10:15 AM on your merchant portal. The portal failed to submit! Our office router had a fiber cable cut at that exact time, but your portal should be able to submit bookings even when our computer is disconnected from the internet! We demand immediate VIP compensation for disruption and an IT engineer to visit our office!
complaints.requested_resolution: VIP financial credit and onsite IT technician dispatch for local internet fault

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Merchant API or portal connectivity failure caused by client-side network interruption
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Contradictory technical claim: VIP client confirms local ISP fiber disconnection at their premises while asserting SupportNova web portal must function offline.

complaints.title: Customer demands parcel be delivered to their car in moving traffic on Shahrah-e-Faisal
complaints.description: My parcel CN-7729104823 was out for delivery to PECHS Karachi. I was running late for work, so I called the rider and told him to intercept my silver Corolla while I was driving down Shahrah-e-Faisal near Baloch Flyover at 50 km/h and hand the package through my window. The rider completely refused and said it is hazardous and impossible! What kind of pathetic service is this? Deliver to my moving car or refund my delivery charges!
complaints.requested_resolution: Full refund of shipping and reprimand to rider for refusing traffic intercept delivery

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Consignee demanding unsafe or hazardous non-standard delivery handover in transit
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Contradictory & hazardous delivery demand: Customer demands courier rider engage in life-threatening moving vehicle handoff on major expressway, violating safety regulations.

complaints.title: Shipper complains parcel arrived too fast and consignee was not ready to receive it in Islamabad
complaints.description: I sent a birthday dress via CN-1029482711 from Lahore to Islamabad under Standard Overnight. You delivered it in exactly 18 hours on Tuesday morning! My cousin's birthday is on Saturday, so she wasn't expecting it until Thursday. Because you delivered it ahead of expected time, she had to cancel her hair salon appointment to receive the rider! I want a full refund of shipping charges because you delivered too quickly!
complaints.requested_resolution: Full refund of shipping fee because parcel was delivered ahead of schedule

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Consignee disputes standard domestic delivery completed well within overnight SLA window
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Contradictory frivolous complaint: Consignee demands monetary refund on the grounds that Overnight courier transit was completed too promptly.

complaints.title: Merchant demands billing waiver for weight adjustment while admitting scale was uncalibrated
complaints.description: We are Karachi Garments (Merchant MER-1029). RaftarXpress re-weighed our 50 bulk parcels and charged volumetric weight of 1.8 kg instead of the 0.5 kg we entered on portal. We admit our warehouse scale was broken and our staff guessed the weight, but as our logistics partner, you should not penalize us by charging actual weight! We demand a full reversal of the PKR 6,500 weight adjustment charge immediately!
complaints.requested_resolution: Full reversal of PKR 6,500 volumetric weight billing adjustment

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Merchant disputes re-weighing volumetric discrepancy verified by automated dimensioning scans
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Contradictory billing claim: Merchant admits their internal weighing equipment was non-functional and declared weight was inaccurate, but demands cancellation of verified audit billing.

complaints.title: Requesting 60-day retroactive insurance compensation claim for lost parcel without prior declaration
complaints.description: I shipped an undeclared luxury watch worth PKR 120,000 under CN-1928301928 back in July from Lahore to Multan. The parcel went missing two months ago. I know the standard policy strictly requires lost claims to be lodged within 14 days, and basic carriage coverage limit is PKR 3,000 for uninsured goods. However, I was traveling in Europe for 8 weeks and couldn't file earlier. Make a special executive policy exception and pay me the full PKR 120,000!
complaints.requested_resolution: Full insurance payout of PKR 120,000 filed 60 days post-incident for uninsured parcel

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Customer claim filed outside 14-day mandatory claim submission window for lost consignment
expected_ground_truth.secondary_issue: Uninsured high-value parcel loss exceeding standard liability coverage limits
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Policy exception request: Customer explicitly acknowledges exceeding the 14-day statutory claims window by 45+ days and lacking declared insurance, requesting manual override.

complaints.title: Merchant requesting waiver of COD remittance service fee for entire quarterly volume
complaints.description: We are TrendyMart Faisalabad (MER-5519). We have shipped over 800 COD parcels this quarter. We are asking your management to grant us a special waiver of the 2% COD processing tariff for all July-September shipments, totaling PKR 42,000. Our profit margins are tight due to inflation. We know our standard contract states 2% fee, but as a loyal merchant, we expect SupportNova to waive this fee retroactively!
complaints.requested_resolution: Retroactive waiver and refund of PKR 42,000 contractual COD processing fees

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Merchant requesting retrospective waiver of standard contractual COD management fee
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Policy exception request: Merchant requests retroactive exemption from legally binding tariff schedule without contractual amendment.

complaints.title: Demanding RaftarXpress accept shipment of unregistered lithium battery packs and fireworks
complaints.description: We visited your Gulberg Express Center in Lahore with 15 unmarked cartons containing industrial lithium-ion batteries and decorative stage fireworks for a wedding event in Islamabad. The booking agent refused the shipment, citing Dangerous Goods / Prohibited Articles policy! This is ridiculous bureaucracy. We are willing to sign an informal paper. Grant an immediate policy exception and dispatch these cartons on tonight's flight!
complaints.requested_resolution: Management exception to ship prohibited hazardous dangerous goods via air cargo

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Shipper attempts booking prohibited hazardous materials / dangerous goods without IATA compliance
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Prohibited policy exception: Attempt to transport undeclared hazardous Class 9 lithium batteries and Class 1 explosives; strict rejection under aviation safety law.

complaints.title: Corporate client requesting exemption from demurrage charges at Karachi bonded freight terminal
complaints.description: This is Atlas Heavy Industries (CORP-902). Our container FWD-4401923 remained parked at your Karachi West Wharf bonded yard for 18 days due to our internal customs clearance delays. SupportNova has invoiced PKR 54,000 in storage demurrage. As an enterprise client, we request an extraordinary policy exception to wipe out 100% of these storage fees since the delay was caused by our clearing agent's family emergency.
complaints.requested_resolution: 100% waiver of PKR 54,000 container yard demurrage charges

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Client requesting demurrage storage fee waiver caused by consignee-side customs delay
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Policy exception request: Demurrage accrued due to third-party broker delays; policy DOC-004 strictly mandates terminal demurrage billing after 72 free hours.

complaints.title: Customer demands delivery rider accept post-dated bank cheque for COD parcel instead of cash
complaints.description: I ordered an electronic generator CN-6601928374 with COD amount PKR 48,000 in Peshawar. When the rider came, I offered him an Account Payee cheque dated for next month 15th because cash is currently tied up. The rider refused to hand over the parcel! I have an account with Meezan Bank for 10 years! Allow an exception, instruct the rider to accept the post-dated cheque, and leave the parcel with me today!
complaints.requested_resolution: Exception to standard COD payment instruments by accepting post-dated personal cheque

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Consignee attempts payment with unauthorized payment instrument on Cash-on-Delivery
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Policy exception request: Consignee demands rider accept post-dated cheque; COD policy strictly accepts physical cash or verified digital QR payment at doorstep.

complaints.title: Merchant requesting free long-term warehouse storage past contracted 30-day fulfillment window
complaints.description: We are Urban Footwear (MER-7712). We have 2,000 pairs of unsold winter shoes occupying 15 pallet positions at Multan Fulfillment Center. The 30-day free fulfillment turnaround elapsed last month, and SupportNova is now charging PKR 18,000 monthly pallet storage. We ask for a special management exception to waive all storage fees for the next 4 months until winter season starts in December.
complaints.requested_resolution: 4 months of zero-cost warehousing storage exception for slow-moving stock

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Merchant requesting long-term pallet storage fee exemption for aged inventory
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Policy exception request: Merchant requests 120 days of complimentary warehouse space for stagnant SKUs contrary to signed SLA storage fee schedule.

complaints.title: Customer demands delivery after 11:30 PM midnight in residential neighborhood in Lahore
complaints.description: Regarding CN-9018274619 for Model Town Lahore. I work evening shifts and return home at 11:15 PM. Your rider tried to deliver at 4 PM and then at 6:30 PM. I demand that RaftarXpress send the rider exclusively between 11:30 PM and midnight to deliver my parcel. I am a busy person and daytime delivery does not suit me. Make an exception to your standard 9 AM - 8 PM delivery window!
complaints.requested_resolution: Custom midnight delivery schedule between 11:30 PM and 12:00 AM

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Customer requests delivery outside operational business hours and courier shift schedules
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Policy exception request: Customer demands delivery outside authorized operating hours (08:00-20:00), which violates courier labor shifts and residential security guidelines.

complaints.title: VIP corporate account requesting bypass of digital security authentication on merchant portal
complaints.description: We are Elite Distributors (VIP-109). Your new merchant portal update requires mandatory 2-Factor Authentication (SMS OTP) every time our dispatchers log in. Our warehouse staff share a single computer terminal and don't have company mobile phones. We demand SupportNova disable 2FA security exclusively for our merchant account VIP-109 immediately.
complaints.requested_resolution: Account-level bypass of mandatory multi-factor authentication protocol

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Merchant requesting security policy waiver or disabling of mandatory multi-factor authentication
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Policy exception request: Client requests exemption from corporate information security policy (2FA), posing account takeover and data breach risks.

complaints.title: Shipper requesting cash payout instead of bank account transfer for insurance claim
complaints.description: My approved insurance claim for damaged electronics CN-3391028371 was processed for PKR 14,000. Your claims department emailed asking for my IBAN number to initiate bank transfer. I do not have a bank account and do not want to use Easypaisa. I demand your Karachi Head Office hand me physical cash notes over the front desk counter! Make an exception to your corporate banking disbursement policy.
complaints.requested_resolution: Physical cash disbursement for insurance claim payout at company office

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Claimant demands physical cash payout bypassing mandatory corporate digital banking disbursement
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Policy exception request: Claimant demands cash over counter; financial compliance policies strictly mandate traceable electronic banking (IBAN/digital wallet) for claim disbursements.

complaints.title: Requesting parcel release to neighbor without consignee OTP or written authorization
complaints.description: I have parcel CN-5510293847 arriving at my flat in Clifton Karachi. I am currently out of town in Dubai. The rider called and asked for the delivery OTP. I don't have roaming SMS access to receive OTP. I told the rider to just hand it to any neighbor on the 4th floor without OTP or signature. The rider refused and said OTP is required. Override the system and mark delivered without OTP verification!
complaints.requested_resolution: Bypass OTP security protocol and release package to unverified third party

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Consignee requesting OTP delivery verification bypass for third-party parcel handover
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Policy exception request: Consignee demands disabling OTP delivery safeguard for neighbor release, which creates massive fraud and lost-parcel liability.

complaints.title: Merchant demands 0% commission on return orders and free return shipping for customer refusals
complaints.description: We run Glamour Wear (MER-3341) on RaftarXpress COD network. When customers reject COD parcels at doorstep, you charge us standard RTO return shipping of PKR 150 per consignment. We demand an ongoing policy exemption: all customer refusal return shipments must be delivered back to our warehouse 100% free of charge! We should not bear logistics costs when buyers change their mind!
complaints.requested_resolution: Zero-cost RTO reverse freight policy exception for all refused COD parcels

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Merchant disputes contractual reverse logistics RTO handling and transit charges
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Policy exception request: Merchant seeks permanent exemption from reverse logistics operational tariffs explicitly stated in standard Merchant Service Agreement.

complaints.title: Customer demands courier hold parcel at destination hub for 45 calendar days free of charge
complaints.description: I have package CN-8819203948 arrived at Islamabad Blue Area Hub. I have traveled to Skardu on an extended hiking expedition and will return after 6 weeks (45 days). Your hub manager called saying parcels can only be held for 7 days before RTO return to sender. I instruct RaftarXpress to hold my package safely on hub shelf for 45 days without returning or charging holding fees!
complaints.requested_resolution: 45-day parcel retention exception at destination hub without RTO or demurrage fees

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Consignee requests indefinite parcel retention at destination hub exceeding maximum 7-day threshold
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Policy exception request: Request to retain consignment at destination retail hub for 45 days violates DOC-003 standard 7-day RTO return timeline.

complaints.title: Corporate freight client demands waiver of verified fuel surcharge adjustment
complaints.description: This is Indus Agro Chemicals (CORP-442). Our monthly freight invoice INV-88291 includes PKR 38,000 for government-mandated Diesel Fuel Surcharge (FSC) adjustment. We know the contract contains an indexed fuel escalation clause linked to OGRA diesel price increases, but our company budget is exhausted for this quarter. We demand SupportNova waive the fuel surcharge line item across all August freight shipments!
complaints.requested_resolution: Full waiver of PKR 38,000 contractual Fuel Surcharge line item

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Corporate client disputes contractually indexed fuel surcharge (FSC) rate adjustment
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Policy exception request: Client requests unilateral cancellation of contractually agreed fuel surcharge linked to verified regulatory fuel index.

complaints.title: Individual customer demands home pickup of unpackaged loose clothing items in plastic shopping bag
complaints.description: I booked a courier pickup for CN-1928374650 from Gulshan Karachi. I had 6 unstitched suits in an open Shopper (polythene bag) without tape, flyer, or shipping label. The pickup rider refused to take it unless it was packed in a standard courier flyer with airway bill barcode. I do not have packing materials or a printer! Instruct your rider to take the loose items in his backpack and handle packing at the hub without charging me flyer costs!
complaints.requested_resolution: Exemption from packaging standards; rider to collect unpackaged open goods

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Shipper demands pickup of unpackaged unsealed goods without compliant barcode labeling
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Policy exception request: Shipper demands carrier accept unsealed unpackaged cargo, violating DOC-002 basic courier intake rules.

complaints.title: Merchant requesting exception to allow shipping perishable raw frozen meat via standard courier network
complaints.description: We are Gourmet Organic Foods Lahore (MER-6619). We want to ship 50 boxes of raw frozen mutton steaks to individual retail customers in Karachi and Islamabad using your standard 24-48 hour parcel courier service. Your account manager informed us raw perishables are restricted under DOC-002. We request special executive permission to dispatch these frozen meat consignments in regular dry parcel vans without temperature logging.
complaints.requested_resolution: Executive authorization to ship perishable raw meat through ambient standard network

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Shipper requesting booking approval for raw perishable food items via ambient courier network
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Policy exception request: Perishable food shipment in non-refrigerated ambient transit violates health safety protocols and carrier carriage rules.

complaints.title: Customer demands cancellation and full refund of international courier booking after customs dispatch
complaints.description: I booked international express document parcel INT-9918237 from Islamabad to London (UK) and paid PKR 12,500. The parcel was cleared by Pakistan Customs at Islamabad Airport and is on board the flight to Heathrow. I changed my mind this afternoon because my visa got delayed. I want RaftarXpress to cancel the flight mid-air, return the document envelope back to my home in Islamabad, and refund 100% of my PKR 12,500 fee!
complaints.requested_resolution: Mid-transit international flight cancellation, reverse shipment, and 100% fee refund

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Consignor requests mid-air cancellation and full refund for international consignment handed over to airline
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Policy exception & impossible request: Customer demands cancellation of international cargo already processed through customs and airline uplift; non-refundable under aviation terms.

complaints.title: VIP Merchant requests waiver of SLA delivery standard penalties incurred on their self-packed bad shipments
complaints.description: We are Royale Furnishings (VIP-303). We had 12 shipments returned by customers in Faisalabad because our own staff forgot to include assembly hardware screws in the cartons. SupportNova billed us standard return freight charges totaling PKR 4,800. As a VIP merchant delivering high volume, we request VIP waiver of these return charges because it was an honest human mistake by our packing team.
complaints.requested_resolution: VIP waiver of PKR 4,800 return freight charges for merchant internal packing omission

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: VIP merchant requesting waiver of return shipping fees caused by merchant packing omissions
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Policy exception request: VIP merchant admits merchant-side dispatch error (omitted parts) but requests waiver of carrier legitimate return handling costs.

complaints.title: Demanding PKR 500,000 consequential business damages for delayed delivery of ordinary textile samples
complaints.description: We sent a 1 kg parcel of cotton cloth swatches (CN-4419203847) from Faisalabad to Lahore. It was delivered in 30 hours instead of 24 hours (a 6-hour delay). We claim that because of this delay, an international buyer from Germany canceled a potential export contract worth 2 Million Rupees! We demand RaftarXpress pay us PKR 500,000 for lost business profits and commercial opportunity damages!
complaints.requested_resolution: PKR 500,000 compensation for indirect/consequential lost commercial contract

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Shipper claiming indirect consequential commercial damages for minor domestic transit delay
expected_ground_truth.secondary_issue: Standard domestic transit delay under 24 hours without perishable contents
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Unsupported consequential damages claim: Carrier carriage terms (DOC-001/DOC-003) strictly disclaim indirect, incidental, or consequential business loss.

complaints.title: Customer demands full refund for parcel delivered to family member at verified residential address
complaints.description: Tracking CN-8819203841 shows delivered to my home in Johar Town Lahore. The POD receipt was signed by my real brother who lives with me in the same house. However, I wanted the parcel handed directly to my own hands! Because my brother took the box and kept it on the dining table, I consider the delivery invalid. I demand a 100% refund of the shipping fee and PKR 2,000 compensation!
complaints.requested_resolution: 100% delivery fee refund and PKR 2,000 compensation for delivery to adult household member

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Consignee disputes valid POD signed by adult family member at designated residential address
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Unsupported refund claim: POD verification confirms delivery to adult resident at consignee address in accordance with DOC-001 Section 4 delivery rules.

complaints.title: Merchant demanding reimbursement for goods confiscated by government tax authorities at inter-provincial checkpost
complaints.description: We are Frontier Electronics (MER-4920). Our consignment CN-7719203845 carrying 40 untaxed imported tablets from Peshawar to Karachi was intercepted and seized by Sindh Revenue Board / Customs at the provincial border due to lack of valid sales tax invoices and import documentation. We demand RaftarXpress reimburse us PKR 680,000 for the confiscated goods since it was in your truck!
complaints.requested_resolution: PKR 680,000 compensation for regulatory confiscation of un-invoiced goods

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Consignment seized by statutory government authorities due to shipper lack of legal tax documentation
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Unsupported refund claim: Loss caused by statutory government confiscation due to consignor non-compliance; carrier liability excluded under Section 12 of carriage terms.

complaints.title: Demanding compensation for antique pottery damaged due to lack of internal cushioning by sender
complaints.description: I received an antique clay urn shipped from Bahawalpur to Islamabad under CN-2210948371. The urn had no bubble wrap, styrofoam, or thermocol around it—just placed loosely in a thin cardboard box. When opened, the pottery was cracked. Even though the sender packed it poorly, RaftarXpress accepted the box, so you are 100% liable! Pay me PKR 25,000 for the broken antique pottery immediately!
complaints.requested_resolution: PKR 25,000 compensation for damaged fragile pottery packed without cushioning

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Parcel contents damaged due to non-compliant or inadequate customer packaging
expected_ground_truth.secondary_issue: Damage to fragile or glassware items shipped without declared fragile handling
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Unsupported claim: Physical inspection confirms zero internal protective cushioning for brittle terracotta pottery; claim inadmissible under DOC-002 packaging rules.

complaints.title: Merchant demands refund of shipping fees for parcels successfully delivered on first attempt
complaints.description: This is MegaBoutique Lahore (MER-1102). In August we shipped 250 prepaid parcels across Pakistan. All 250 parcels were successfully delivered within 24-48 hours with signed PODs. However, because our business experienced lower than expected retail sales this month, we request SupportNova refund 50% of the total shipping charges (PKR 45,000) to support our cash flow!
complaints.requested_resolution: 50% retrospective rebate on successfully fulfilled standard deliveries

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Merchant disputes fulfilled logistics billing without operational failure or SLA breach
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Unsupported refund request: Full SLA compliance achieved across all consignments; carrier cannot subsidize client merchant retail sales performance.

complaints.title: Customer demands compensation for stress caused by tracking page loading slowly on 2G mobile data
complaints.description: I was tracking parcel CN-5501928374 while traveling on a bus near Sahiwal. The tracking webpage took 15 seconds to open on my mobile phone because mobile reception was weak. This caused me severe anxiety and emotional distress thinking my parcel was lost! The parcel was delivered safely 2 hours later, but I demand PKR 10,000 compensation for mental trauma caused by slow webpage loading!
complaints.requested_resolution: PKR 10,000 mental trauma compensation for mobile tracking page latency

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Customer reporting tracking portal accessibility latency caused by client mobile connection
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Unsupported frivolous compensation claim: Consignment delivered flawlessly within SLA; carrier portal server logs show 99.9% uptime and zero server-side outages.

complaints.title: Consignee demands COD refund from courier because seller sent replica shoes instead of original
complaints.description: I bought Nike sneakers from a Facebook page, delivered under COD tracking CN-9918273645 in Faisalabad. I paid PKR 8,500 to your rider. When I opened the box, the shoes are counterfeit copies made in China! The Facebook seller has blocked my number. Since RaftarXpress collected my money, you must refund my PKR 8,500 immediately to my EasyPaisa account! RaftarXpress is responsible for scam sellers!
complaints.requested_resolution: Full refund of PKR 8,500 COD amount due to third-party merchant counterfeit merchandise

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Customer received counterfeit or replica goods from third-party e-commerce seller
expected_ground_truth.secondary_issue: Consignee disputes COD amount after delivery completion
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Unsupported carrier refund: Courier operates strictly as a third-party logistics intermediary and cannot adjudicate or refund merchant product authenticity disputes.

complaints.title: Corporate client demanding refund of warehousing fees because their goods were unsold during rainy season
complaints.description: This is Zenith Air Conditioners (CORP-601). We stored 400 AC units at your Karachi Korangi warehouse facility from April to August under agreed monthly pallet storage rates (INV-77291, PKR 160,000). Due to unexpected prolonged monsoon rain and cool weather, our retail sales dropped by 70%. We demand RaftarXpress refund 50% of the warehousing fees because your warehouse did not generate sales for us!
complaints.requested_resolution: PKR 80,000 rebate on warehouse storage fees due to client commercial market downturn

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Client disputes verified warehouse storage invoicing based on client commercial sales performance
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Unsupported refund claim: Warehouse space, physical security, and asset handling were fully provided per contract; carrier holds no responsibility for commercial market demand.

complaints.title: Demanding cash compensation for delivery delay caused by nationwide cellular network shutdown
complaints.description: My document consignment CN-3301928472 from Lahore to Islamabad was delayed by 18 hours on 9th Muharram. The government ordered a complete nationwide cellular network and GPS shutdown for security reasons, so your riders couldn't navigate or call consignees. I know it was a government security block, but RaftarXpress should have satellite phones! Pay me PKR 15,000 compensation for this delay!
complaints.requested_resolution: PKR 15,000 compensation for transit delay during statutory government telecoms blackout

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Transit delay caused by documented Force Majeure event / government cellular service suspension
expected_ground_truth.secondary_issue: Standard domestic transit delay under 24 hours without perishable contents
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Unsupported claim: Delay caused by Force Majeure statutory security directive (telecoms shutdown); carrier liability expressly exempted under DOC-001 Section 9.

complaints.title: Merchant demands refund of return shipping charges after customer refused parcel due to wrong size sent by merchant
complaints.description: We are Karachi Footwear (MER-2209). We dispatched shoes under CN-6619203841 to a customer in Multan. The buyer rejected delivery because our packing department mistakenly sent Size 7 instead of Size 9. SupportNova returned the parcel to our warehouse and billed PKR 180 return freight. We demand you waive the PKR 180 and refund the outbound PKR 220 shipping charge because the customer refused the package!
complaints.requested_resolution: Refund of outbound shipping and cancellation of return freight for merchant order error

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Merchant disputes return charges on customer refusal resulting from merchant dispatch error
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Unsupported refund claim: The root cause of delivery refusal was merchant internal fulfillment error; carrier performed both outbound and return logistics services per contract.

complaints.title: Customer demands compensation for lost value of cash currency notes shipped in standard flyer
complaints.description: I secretly mailed PKR 50,000 in physical currency notes inside an opaque birthday card envelope under CN-1029384756 from Rawalpindi to Sialkot. The parcel flyer arrived torn and the currency notes were missing. I demand 100% reimbursement of PKR 50,000! I did not declare cash on the airway bill because I didn't want anyone to know, but RaftarXpress must reimburse every single rupee!
complaints.requested_resolution: Full cash reimbursement of PKR 50,000 undeclared physical currency notes

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Shipper sent prohibited physical currency / legal tender in violation of carriage terms
expected_ground_truth.secondary_issue: Partial pilferage or tampering of parcel flyer contents
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Unsupported refund & illegal carriage: Shipment of physical currency / negotiable instruments is strictly prohibited under DOC-002; zero indemnity liability applies under State Bank regulations.

complaints.title: Corporate freight client demands refund of detention charges when their own factory forklift was broken
complaints.description: This is Pakistan Steel Fabricators (CORP-109). Truck FWD-9918234 arrived at our Lahore plant at 9 AM. Our overhead factory crane broke down, so we could not offload the steel girders until 8 PM (11 hours truck detention). SupportNova invoiced vehicle detention charges of PKR 12,000. We demand complete cancellation and refund of this invoice because the crane failure was an unexpected mechanical mishap at our factory!
complaints.requested_resolution: Full cancellation of PKR 12,000 vehicle detention charges

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Client disputes verified freight vehicle detention charges caused by consignee site equipment failure
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Unsupported claim: Freight vehicle detention exceeded contractual 3-hour free unloading window due to consignee offloading breakdown; detention tariff is legally enforceable.

complaints.title: VIP Merchant demands financial compensation for minor 5-minute scheduled portal maintenance
complaints.description: We are TechZone VIP (VIP-550). On Sunday at 3:00 AM, SupportNova conducted announced routine database server maintenance for 15 minutes. We claim that during those 15 minutes, we were unable to upload 3 bulk orders. We demand PKR 25,000 VIP SLA breach compensation for this scheduled maintenance window!
complaints.requested_resolution: PKR 25,000 VIP compensation for pre-announced scheduled weekend server maintenance

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Merchant claiming financial compensation for scheduled pre-announced maintenance window within SLA allowances
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Unsupported compensation claim: Standard SLA contract explicitly permits scheduled off-peak maintenance with 48-hour prior notice; zero SLA penalty applies.

complaints.title: Customer demands full price refund of dress because rider did not carry change for PKR 5,000 note
complaints.description: I had a COD parcel CN-7701928341 for PKR 1,200 in Gujranwala. When the rider arrived, I gave him a crisp PKR 5,000 currency note. The rider did not have PKR 3,800 change in his pocket, so he asked me to get change from the nearby grocery shop or pay via JazzCash QR. I had to walk 50 meters in the heat to get change! I demand RaftarXpress refund the full PKR 1,200 cost of the dress to compensate me for the inconvenience of walking to the shop!
complaints.requested_resolution: 100% refund of merchandise cost (PKR 1,200) for rider currency change unavailability

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Rider lacks exact currency change for high-denomination currency banknote at delivery
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Unsupported refund claim: Rider change unavailability is an operational inconvenience addressed via digital payments; does not entitle customer to free merchandise refund.

complaints.title: Merchant demands refund of packing material charges for boxes consumed during order fulfillment
complaints.description: We are Sialkot Sports Gear (MER-8812). Last month we purchased 300 custom branded corrugated boxes from RaftarXpress packaging supplies (INV-55102, PKR 15,000). All 300 boxes were used to ship boxing gloves to our customers. We now request SupportNova refund the PKR 15,000 box cost because our profit margin on boxing gloves was smaller than anticipated.
complaints.requested_resolution: Full refund of PKR 15,000 packaging consumable supplies invoice

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Merchant disputes consumed packaging supplies invoice based on commercial profit margins
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Unsupported refund claim: Packaging materials were delivered, consumed, and utilized in commerce; carrier is not liable for merchant product profitability.

complaints.title: Customer demands compensation because parcel exterior carton had ordinary road dust on it
complaints.description: I received parcel CN-9901827463 delivered to Peshawar University campus. The contents inside were in 100% perfect working condition. However, the outer brown cardboard box had a thin layer of road dust on the top surface from being in the back of the delivery van! I expect pristine spotless boxes with zero microscopic dust particles! Pay me PKR 3,000 compensation for ruining my unboxing aesthetic experience!
complaints.requested_resolution: PKR 3,000 unboxing aesthetic compensation for minor superficial carton dust

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Customer complaints regarding superficial cosmetic dust on outer packaging with intact contents
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Unsupported frivolous claim: Minor ambient dust on protective outer shipping carton does not constitute transit damage when enclosed goods are completely pristine.
